verdict.rationale: Highnote is an API/GraphQL-first platform with a Node.js SDK, webhooks, and a full-featured Test environment that mirrors Live functionality, all of which support running interactions programmatically without a UI (e.g., in CI or automated pipelines). However, there is no explicit documentation of a CLI, CI pipeline integration, or headless automation guidance beyond the general API/SDK access. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, a documented CLI or headless mode, and independent confirmation of automated pipeline usage.
